posts.author: dpk1994
posts.community: Ola Electric - Full Stack EV play?
posts.text: Mahashakti is expected to be based on prismatic LFP battery which is still under development. R&D is expected to be completed by Dec 2026. So he maybe right in a sense that Ola announced MoU before Prismatic cells are ready. I would also advise caution against such blogs as they are often based on individual limited research and knowledge. MoUs are an indicator of product acceptance in the market and also act as an anchor customer. For example if a company is building a chemical plant they will get some anchor customers who will Commit to the portion of installed capacity even before the plant…

posts.community: Ola Electric - Full Stack EV play?
posts.text: What a pivot from earlier B2C model to B2B. I remember Bhavish said they are confident about B2C model as it has superior margins and they have cracked the model, etc. It seems that he understood the complexities involved with B2C model, as Ola is struggling for several quarters to scale the logistics, supply chain, service infra. With B2B most of these will be taken care by the dealer. It will be in dealers interest too to maintain right level of inventories, spare parts, servicing staff, etc. I believe the problems Ola is facing until now has more to do with their lack of service infrastruct…
